name: Five Little Children — School Bus Countdown
competency: Counting down backwards, stepwise subtraction, linking action rhymes with mathematical removal
ncertStandard: Grade 1 Mathematics: Joyful Mathematics Chapter 3 (Five Little Children)
overview: A yellow school bus travels across road stops. Children wave and disembark one by one to the tune of the NCERT rhyme ('Five little children, raise your hand... Now, we are four!'). Children calculate remaining passengers down to 'none' (0).
learningOutcomes: Recite and apply sequential backwards counting (5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 0)
Recognize 'none' as zero in daily life situations (bus passengers leaving)

levels.name: Rhyme Bus (5 Children)
levels.description: NCERT original 5-verse rhyme with 1 child leaving per stop

levels.name: Excursion Tour Bus (10 Children)
levels.description: Groups of 2 or 3 passengers leaving at each stop
